title: Blender Python API for procedural heads

queue.claim: Camera shift_x/shift_y are multiplied by the fitted image dimension (W under HORIZONTAL, H under VERTICAL, max(W,H) only under AUTO), per BKE_camera_params_compute_viewplane. The engine's to_blender_camera divides by max(W,H) under HORIZONTAL, which is wrong for portrait photos.
queue.query: Blender camera shift units sensor_fit HORIZONTAL BKE_camera_params_compute_viewplane viewfac shiftx

queue.claim: Bundled Python is 3.11 in Blender 4.1-4.5; 5.0 probably still 3.11; 5.1-5.3 either 3.11 or 3.13. NumPy is 1.2x in 4.x and unknown (1.26 or 2.x) in 5.x.
queue.query: Blender 5.1 release notes Python 3.13 NumPy 2 upgrade

queue.claim: foreach_get/foreach_set uses a fast buffer path only when the NumPy dtype matches the RNA type (float32 coordinates, int32 indices) and the array is contiguous; otherwise it silently falls back to a per-item path about 5-20x slower.
queue.query: Blender foreach_set numpy float32 vs float64 performance buffer protocol

queue.claim: Once shape keys exist, writing me.vertices co in object mode does not last: it is overwritten from the reference (Basis) key on the next entry into edit mode, so the Basis key block must be written.
queue.query: Blender python change mesh vertices co with shape keys reverts basis edit mode
